newsitem.title: USA: Pentair sees acquisition adding to '98 net.
newsitem.headline: Pentair sees acquisition adding to '98 net.

text.p: Pentair Inc said Monday the acquisition of P&F Technologies Inc, a refrigerant recycling company, will add to its 1998 earnings.

Pentair did not quantify how much the acquisition of P&F by its Century Manufacturing unit will add to earnings. It said P&F is currently profitable but did not disclose the amount of P&F's annual sales.
P&F makes and markets automotive and commercial refrigerant recycling systems and accessories under the Viper and Cobra brand names.
Pentair said the acquisition was financed through existing lines of credit.

"P&F Technologies' products, combined with Century's existing lines of Solar-brand recyclers, expands our market share and gives Century a springboard into the emerging international refrigerant recycler market," G. Robert Gey, president of Pentair's vehicle service equipment businesses, said in a statement.
